ticks.note: Tick 1: no alarm in either chart.
A fault: both alarms go on.
The operator acknowledges while the fault is still present. `AlarmResetWins` takes `if ack` and switches its alarm off. `AlarmSetWins` tests `ack && !fault`, which is false: its alarm stays on.
`AlarmResetWins` is back in `Normal`, sees the fault again and raises the alarm once more: the acknowledgement was wasted. `AlarmSetWins` is still alarming.
The fault clears. Both alarms stay latched until someone acknowledges.
Acknowledged, with the fault gone: both alarms go off.
